people.name: Manager Kim
people.note: Former North Korean and South Korean black-ops agent, coded 'Agent 66', posing as an ordinary bank manager.

people.name: Seong Han Su
people.note: Former Olympic taekwondo champion who runs a dojo; Kim's old comrade.

people.name: Park Jin Cheol
people.note: Marine Corps veteran of the Cheonsan special forces unit; Kim's old comrade.

people.name: Kim Min Ji
people.note: Kim's teenage daughter, a bullied sophomore at Songin High School.

people.name: Im Yu Jin
people.note: Kim's wife, who died giving birth to Min Ji.; Min Ji's mother

people.name: Kim Nam Hoon
people.note: Min Ji's crush; the one classmate who was kind to her.

people.name: Ju Hye Ri
people.note: Gang Chan's daughter, Min Ji's classmate and the bully whose brick starts everything

people.name: Seong Min Ho
people.note: Hye Ri's gangster friend, who lured Min Ji into the ambush with Nam Hoon's phone

people.name: Jung Sang A
people.note: SMD agent undercover as Kim's bank coworker.

people.name: Mr. Im
people.note: Laundromat owner near Kim's home, secretly an SMD agent monitoring him.

people.name: Kang Guk Cheol / Mole Cricket
people.note: Director of the Special Missions Directorate, coded 'Mole Cricket'.

people.name: General Jang
people.note: General overseeing the 'Cheonsan' special forces unit; one of few who values Kim's service.

people.name: Im Do Hyeon
people.note: Vice Minister of National Security, in Gang Chan's pocket — and Kim's hostage at the standoff

people.name: Park Gang Seong
people.note: North Korean operative sent to capture Kim; Park Yeong Gwang's younger brother.

people.name: Ri Eung Ryeong
people.note: Director General of North Korea's intelligence bureau on the South.

people.name: Park Yeong Gwang
people.note: Kim's closest comrade in the North, killed in a betrayed mission; Gang Seong's older brother.

people.name: Ju Gang Chan
people.note: President of Juhak Construction who rules through corruption and violence.

people.name: Director Nam
people.note: Gang Chan's chief of staff and enforcer.

people.name: Golden Teeth
people.note: Gangster with an old score to settle against Gang Chan, who once tore out his teeth.

people.name: Kim Sang Man
people.note: Subordinate of Golden Teeth.

people.name: Park Gang Min
people.note: Subordinate of Golden Teeth.

people.name: Sim Jong Seon
people.note: National Assembly member and political ally of Gang Chan.

people.name: Sung Tae Hun
people.note: Han Su's son.

people.name: Ji Yeong
people.note: Jin Cheol's wife, a former Marine Corps brigadier general.

people.name: Park Da Bin
people.note: Jin Cheol's daughter.

links.label: A single father who avoids every fight in the world to keep her safe, and fights the whole world to get her back
links.evidence: he is — by all appearances — nothing more than a mild-mannered salaryman and doting single father

links.label: Died the day Min Ji was born, asking him to forget his past and live as Min Ji's father
links.evidence: His wife died shortly after giving birth, and he’s spent every day since honoring her final request that he live solely as Min-ji’s Dad.

links.label: On his knees to the bully, promising to move his daughter away — and not for the first time
links.evidence: Kim doesn’t hesitate to drop to his knees and promise to transfer Min-ji away

links.label: Betrayed by his kneeling, she stays out and threatens to run if he calls
links.evidence: She decides to spend the night with a friend and threatens to run away if her father attempts to contact her overnight.

links.label: Stayed up all night for a daughter who never came home
links.evidence: Kim stays up all night preparing a special birthday breakfast for her anyway

links.label: Blood on his hands and a Vice Minister held by razor wire, said tenderly across a room of guns
links.evidence: “Min-ji,” he says tenderly, despite all the guns and blood, “let’s go home.”

links.label: Before he surrenders: both of them trying to be brave for the other
links.evidence: He and Min-ji are permitted one last meal together at home.

links.label: 'Manager Kim' is declared dead on both sides of the border, and the two of them start again
links.short: a new name, a new life
links.evidence: At long last, Kim reunites with Min-ji, as both are given new identities and the beginning of a new life.

links.label: One of the three ex-agents who meet once a year and never quite stop bickering
